title: Independent GummiExtra review
result: No remaining blocking finding in the recorded source versions.
scope: Static source, fixture and complete supplied ASM/byte evidence; no new IDA queries, product edits, build, UI or live gameplay.

checks.finding: 225DE0/225CD0/225DB0 use RCX state and EDX checked delta for signed fields +36/+40/+44. 230BD0 uses RCX inline combo, EDX base points; return is deliberately ignored. It reads combo+8, ship+200, state+52. All nine complete byte signatures match the supplied byte evidence.

Target-minus-old is computed in int64 and rejected outside int32. Combo gain reproduces Float32 bonus/100+1 and multiplication before truncation. The upper conversion bound 2147483520 and int64 progress sum exclude positive CVTTSS2SI and signed ADD overflow. Native stock conversion is bounded by nine iterations, retains progress100 and bit4 at saturation.

Gummi-specific BuildContext verifies module membership, heap and scheduler, current ship and embedded state backlinks. Actions require running mission phase8, ship phase2, living HP, no rebirth/dead flags, game thread and a fresh nonzero heartbeat. The handler rebuilds and compares current identity and relevant inputs before a single call; it reads no game pointer afterwards. No persistent pointer or automatic replay is stored.

Mobility and roll use the current playerparam row0. Negative mobility uses the first matching systemparam row0. Resource scans are bounded and full ranges readable. Lock-on rows are verified inside the loaded 128-byte-row table with expected IDs, finite nonnegative parameters and finite proposed products. Current lock-on timers are preserved; future reloads consume the new bonus.

Native 230D20 accepts phase2/index5, increments it to6 at 230E07 and stores phase4/index6 at 230E41/43. Phase4 advances to5 without clearing that index. The final source allows index6 only in phases4/5, while phase1 still requires index<5. This fixes the earlier temporary loss of charge controls/readouts in a legitimate state.

Slots320..329 are published only after current Gummi validation; paused readouts are permitted. Invalid combo suppresses only its three dependent readouts. Numeric snapshots copy values, with no calls or writes. Mutation routing accepts only320..323.

validation.author_run: 492 checks, 0 failures, no warnings, as reported by native_debug for these final source/test hashes.
validation.reviewer: Read the guard and synthetic test source. Independently compared all nine complete byte signatures. Verified actual line counts equal both instruction_count and total_instructions for all supplied48 bodies (2953 instructions); this count validation is not a claim that all48 bodies received independent semantic review.

limitations: No visual gameplay validation was performed. Synthetic native callouts cannot establish real mission behavior.
Tuning checks bound the immediate proposed factor products; they do not prove every later physics calculation for arbitrarily altered resources.
One-time runtime changes are not restored by disconnect/disable and can influence subsequent normal combat and mission results.
